description:
The Labour Skill Training Scheme is an initiative launched by the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB) in India. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2019. 

The primary objective of the Labour Skill Training Scheme is to enhance the employability of construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. 

The scheme aims to provide skill development training to workers in the construction sector. 

The target is to train approximately 50,000 workers annually. 

This training is designed to equip workers with necessary skills that meet industry standards. 

The scheme focuses on various trades related to construction such as masonry, plumbing, electrical work, and carpentry. 

Under this scheme, the government provides financial assistance to the training institutes. 

The amount of financial assistance is up to INR 10,000 per worker for the training program. 

The training duration varies from 15 days to 3 months depending on the trade. 

Workers who complete the training successfully receive a skill development certificate. 

This certificate is recognized by the government and enhances the worker's employability. 

The scheme also aims to reduce unemployment among construction workers in the state. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and detailed. 

Workers must be registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The age limit for applicants is between 18 to 60 years. 

There is no specific educational qualification required for participation in the scheme. 

However, workers must demonstrate a willingness to learn and improve their skills. 

The application process for the Labour Skill Training Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested workers must visit the nearest MPBOCWWB office to obtain the application form. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official MPBOCWWB website. 

Applicants need to provide a copy of their registration certificate with MPBOCWWB. 

Additionally, they must submit a government-issued identity proof such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

Proof of residence may also be required to confirm eligibility. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Upon approval, the applicant is enrolled in a training program based on their selected trade. 

The training is conducted by recognized training institutes across Madhya Pradesh. 

These institutes are selected based on their capability to deliver quality training. 

The training sessions are scheduled periodically throughout the year. 

Disbursement of financial assistance occurs after the successful completion of training. 

Workers receive the financial assistance directly in their bank accounts. 

This financial support is intended to cover any expenses related to training. 

The scheme is implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The contact details for MPBOCWWB are available on their official website. 

The board can be reached at their office located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. 

The phone number for inquiries is +91-755-246-2000. 

The email address for communication is mpbocwwb@mp.gov.in. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its inception. 

As of October 2023, over 30,000 workers have benefited from the training programs. 

This has led to an increase in skilled labor in the construction sector. 

The government has also collaborated with various NGOs to enhance outreach. 

These collaborations aim to ensure that more workers are aware of the scheme. 

The Labour Skill Training Scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote skill development in India. 

It aligns with the national Skill India Mission launched in 2015. 

The Skill India Mission aims to train over 400 million people by 2022. 

The Labour Skill Training Scheme contributes to this national goal by focusing on a specific sector. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of safety training for construction workers. 

Safety training is integrated into the curriculum of the skill development programs. 

This is crucial given the high-risk nature of construction work. 

Workers are taught about safety protocols and equipment handling. 

The scheme also encourages women to participate in skill training. 

Special provisions are made to ensure that women workers have access to training. 

This is part of a broader initiative to empower women in the workforce. 

The Labour Skill Training Scheme is regularly monitored and evaluated. 

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the training programs. 

The government aims to adapt the curriculum based on industry needs. 

This ensures that the skills taught are relevant and up-to-date. 

The scheme also promotes entrepreneurship among trained workers. 

Trained workers are encouraged to start their own businesses in the construction sector. 

This is supported through various government initiatives and financial schemes. 

The Labour Skill Training Scheme is a significant step towards improving the livelihoods of construction workers in Madhya Pradesh. 

By enhancing skills and providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to uplift the economic status of workers. 

Overall, the Labour Skill Training Scheme is a comprehensive initiative that addresses the skill gap in the construction industry. 

It provides a structured approach to skill development and employment generation. 

The scheme's focus on safety and inclusivity further enhances its impact. 

As the construction sector continues to grow, initiatives like these are crucial for sustainable development. 

The Labour Skill Training Scheme is a vital component of Madhya Pradesh's efforts to empower its workforce. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the quality of life for construction workers. 

This scheme stands as a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

The continuous evolution of the scheme will ensure that it remains relevant in a changing economic landscape.
